task: verify an uploaded skill works in the product
definition: After adding a skill to your account, give Claude a matching task to confirm the skill loads and runs in this product.
outcome: a skill already in the user's account has been confirmed to trigger and run in a real conversation in this product

records.outcome: the distributed skill is confirmed to load and be picked up by Claude on a member's device, catching a malformed SKILL.md the upload did not check
preconditions: the plugin has been added on the Plugins card
steps: Open Claude Desktop as a member
Install the plugin if you chose Members choose
Give Claude a task the skill should match
To change the skill later, update the plugin

evidence.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills
evidence.quote: open Claude Desktop as a member: install the plugin if you chose **Members choose**, then give Claude a task the skill should match and confirm Claude picks it up

records.notes: The upload checks packaging, not skill content.

records.outcome: the uploaded skill is enabled and confirmed to load when a matching prompt is given, with its description iterated on if it does not trigger
steps: Enable the skill in Customize > Skills
Try prompts that should trigger it
Review Claude's thinking to confirm it is loading the skill
Iterate on the description if Claude is not using it when expected
records.notes: Customize > Skills is a UI label, not product evidence; product stays at the unit default.
